title: Design System: XDM67X — The Lantern-Lit Quest

display.purpose: Title-screen logotype only; pixel arcade authority.

label.purpose: Chips, dates, rewards, HUD readouts, footer. Never sentences.

body.purpose: All reading copy inside dialogue panels.

shadows.name: pixel-press
shadows.purpose: The only sanctioned shadow: arcade press depth under pixel type.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrances and state transitions.

motion.name: blink
motion.purpose: Arcade blink for carets and INSERT COIN.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Full HUD with level names; two-column stats.

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.purpose: HUD contracts (HP 64px, nameplate crest only), h1 24px, h2 16px, menu destinations hidden.

components.name: Start Button
components.description: The PRESS START control: pixel font, gold on night, fills gold on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-start { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 14px; color: #f2c14e; background: rgba(7,8,26,0.82); border: 2px solid #f2c14e; padding: 18px 30px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s, color .25s, transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-start:hover, .ds-btn-start:focus-visible { background: #f2c14e; color: #05060f; } .ds-btn-start:active { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-start:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2c14e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quest Type Chip
components.description: MAIN QUEST labeling; cyan and green siblings mark side quests and tutorials.
components.css: .ds-quest-chip { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #f2c14e; border: 1px solid rgba(242,193,78,0.32); background: rgba(242,193,78,0.08); padding: 6px 8px; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Dialogue Panel
components.description: The RPG reading surface: near-opaque indigo, gold hairline, pixel corner ticks.
components.html:
Software Engineer · Doctolib

Architected core billing features for Doctolib Médecin.
components.css: .ds-dialogue-panel { position: relative; background: rgba(9,11,24,0.88); border: 1px solid rgba(242,193,78,0.32); padding: 28px 30px 24px; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #d6dbf0; max-width: 60ch; } .ds-dialogue-panel h3 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 14px; color: #d6dbf0; } .ds-dialogue-panel p { font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-dialogue-panel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4px; pointer-events: none; opacity: .55; background: linear-gradient(#f2c14e,#f2c14e) left 0 top 0 / 14px 2px, linear-gradient(#f2c14e,#f2c14e) left 0 top 0 / 2px 14px, linear-gradient(#f2c14e,#f2c14e) right 0 top 0 / 14px 2px, linear-gradient(#f2c14e,#f2c14e) right 0 top 0 / 2px 14px, linear-gradient(#f2c14e,#f2c14e) left 0 bottom 0 / 14px 2px, linear-gradient(#f2c14e,#f2c14e) left 0 bottom 0 / 2px 14px, linear-gradient(#f2c14e,#f2c14e) right 0 bottom 0 / 14px 2px, linear-gradient(#f2c14e,#f2c14e) right 0 bottom 0 / 2px 14px; background-repeat: no-repeat; }

components.name: HUD Level Chip
components.description: Fixed HUD navigation: shows the current level, scrolls to its section.
components.css: .ds-hud-level { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #9aa3c4; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 8px 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: color .25s, border-color .25s, background-color .25s; } .ds-hud-level:hover { color: #d6dbf0; border-color: rgba(214,219,240,0.16); } .ds-hud-level--active, .ds-hud-level:focus-visible { color: #f2c14e; border-color: rgba(242,193,78,0.32); background: rgba(242,193,78,0.07); }

components.name: Inventory Slot
components.description: Signature stat unit: a skill as equipment, never an invented stat bar.
components.css: .ds-inventory-slot { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 9px; } .ds-slot-abbr { width: 46px; height: 46px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #f2c14e; border: 1px solid #b98e35; background: rgba(242,193,78,0.06); } .ds-slot-name { font-family: 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: #9aa3c4; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Side-quest collectible: dialogue panel whose border shifts to the project's color on hover.
components.html:
/01

TwoZeroFourEight

Classic 2048 puzzle game. Fully playable in the browser.
components.css: .ds-project-card { background: rgba(9,11,24,0.88); border: 1px solid rgba(242,193,78,0.32); padding: 24px 26px 22px; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #d6dbf0; transition: border-color .3s; } .ds-project-card:hover, .ds-project-card:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pc, #f2c14e) 70%, rgba(242,193,78,0.32)); } .ds-pc-index { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--pc, #f2c14e); } .ds-pc-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; margin: 10px 0 12px; color: #d6dbf0; } .ds-pc-desc { font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.65; }

components.name: Continue Menu Item
components.description: Game-over menu link: pixel label, destination right-aligned, caret appears on hover.
components.css: .ds-continue-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 15px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .25s, background-color .25s; } .ds-continue-item:hover, .ds-continue-item:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(242,193,78,0.32); background: rgba(242,193,78,0.05); } .ds-menu-label { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #f2c14e; } .ds-menu-dest { justify-self: end; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #9aa3c4; }

components.name: Section Banner
components.description: Level title with flanking brass diamonds under a hairline.
components.css: .ds-banner { text-align: center; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; } .ds-banner::before { content: ''; display: block; height: 1px; margin-bottom: 30px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(242,193,78,0.32), transparent); } .ds-banner h2 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; font-size: 22px; color: #f2c14e; text-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(3,4,10,0.85); } .ds-banner h2::before, .ds-banner h2::after { content: ''; width: 9px; height: 9px; background: #b98e35; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-banner-sub { margin-top: 18px; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9aa3c4; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is one continuous night world the visitor travels by scrolling: a WebGL2 shader sky whose palette and weather shift through five biomes (night hub, dawn ridge, crystal cave, aurora fields, starfield arena), over which arcade chrome floats — a pixel-font HUD with a scroll-driven HP bar, level chips, and a secrets counter. Everything a visitor reads sits inside square RPG dialogue panels with gold hairline borders and corner ticks; everything that moves belongs to the world behind them.

The palette is disciplined to a single guide-light: Lantern Gold carries every action, border, and instrument; Crystal Cyan marks the technical and the playable; three biome accents appear only as chip tints and world colors. Gold never floods fields — the shader sky owns the big color.

The register is playful but honest: game vocabulary (quests, inventory, stats, CONTINUE?) frames factual career content. Nothing in the chrome is allowed to invent claims; nothing in the content is allowed to break the world.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous shader world (fBm nebula, parallax ridgelines, stars, moon, aurora, GPU motes) that blends palettes per section — never a hard cut.
Arcade pixel chrome (Press Start 2P) strictly for logotype, banners, HUD, chips, and labels; Chakra Petch carries every sentence.
Square geometry: zero radii, 1px gold hairlines, 14×2px corner ticks, rotated-square diamonds as trail nodes.

Motion grammar: exponential ease-out entrances (rise + blur clear), blinking chrome, scroll-and-pointer parallax; everything freezes honestly under prefers-reduced-motion, and the site works with no WebGL at all.

rules.name: The One Lantern Rule
rules.body: Gold is the guide-light, never a field. If a screen needs more gold to read as this world, the shader is broken, not the accent budget.

rules.name: The Solid Panel Rule
rules.body: Body copy never floats on the animated sky. Reading text lives on Dialogue Panel surfaces; only display chrome may sit directly on the world, and only on the title screen.

rules.name: The Pixel Chrome Rule
rules.body: Press Start 2P appears only as chrome — logotype, banners, chips, HUD, controls, labels — never for sentences. Chakra Petch carries anything a visitor reads for meaning.

rules.name: The 12-Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: No text below 12px anywhere, pixel or body. The smallest labels stay legible over the night world.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A panel states its elevation once, as a border — never border plus soft shadow. Hover raises border color, not box-shadow.

dos: Do keep every sentence on a near-opaque Dialogue Panel; only display chrome sits on the sky, and only on the title screen.
Do blend biome palettes continuously through scroll; the world is one journey, not five decorated sections.
Do use authored pixel-grid SVG icons on a 2px unit for every icon need.
Do keep motion exponential ease-out (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) and reach past transform/opacity (blur clear, clip-path banner wipes) where it stays smooth.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion everywhere: static world frame, no boot typing, no tilt, instant reveals — and keep the CSS-gradient fallback world for no-WebGL browsers.
donts: Don't put radii on panels or controls; the world is square.
Don't invent stat numbers or proficiency bars — lists render as inventory slots and traits, honestly.
Don't use Press Start 2P for sentences or body copy.
Don't add a seventh UI accent; new color arrives through the shader's biome palettes, not the chrome.
